# Candidate dependency notices

These files were collected on 2026-11-12 from PyPI wheels or source distributions for the versions identified in `../BUNDLED-COMPONENTS.md`. They preserve the upstream notice bytes. Six major libraries have native files matched to the PyPI wheels; the PyAudio and SoundFile Python modules also match their source distributions, and SoundFile's libsndfile DLL matches its wheel. Other component identifiers are based on embedded version strings and are not all byte-for-byte verified.

This is a working collection, not yet a complete distribution notice bundle. The audit lists native runtimes and package notices still to verify. `pyaudio/PKG-INFO` contains the original PyAudio copyright and permission notice. `soundfile/COPYING` and `soundfile/LICENSE` are from its matching Windows wheel.

`gui/` contains notice files from the local build environment for GUI and packaging dependencies. `runtime/` contains candidate licenses for the Python, Tcl/Tk, OpenSSL and libffi components; its `SOURCES.json` records where each was obtained. They are candidates where the exact bundled build has not yet been established. `portaudio/` contains the license from the revision reported by the legacy native extension. `wincertstore/` preserves the matched source file and its copyright header; `setuptools/` contains a license shared by several matching candidate versions, not proof of an exact version.
